public_facts.title: Affiliate program private pilot and application status
public_facts.summary: Wake'n'Bake Lounge and Compassionate Care Cultivators are currently running a bounded, five-person private Affiliate pilot. Public applications are closed. Private pilot invitations are issued directly to invited candidates. An invitation allows a person to apply, but application and invitation do not equal approval. Review and human owner authorization are required.

public_facts.title: Affiliate eligibility and approval requirements
public_facts.summary: Affiliate candidates are reviewed individually. There is no follower minimum or audience threshold required to be considered; authentic community trust and alignment matter most. Identity verification, active promotional channels, ethical fit, compliance commitments (FTC disclosures and no medical claims), and owner review are required before approval.

public_facts.title: Affiliate eligible offers and governed commission categories
public_facts.summary: Affiliates can promote approved CCSS catalog offers. Governed commission classes are: Wellness Physical products (Therapeutic Body Butter, Tinctures) 30%, Cannabis Botanical Collection Vol. 1 25%, Infused Basics 25%, 1-on-1 Consultations (Is Cannabis Right For Me?) 30%, full educational courses 15%, Legends NFT Memberships 10%, and Wellness subscriptions at 30% for qualifying payments 1-3 then 5% for payments 4+. Excluded, paused, rate-required, and unreleased community products (such as Lounge Pass or Lounge Member drafts) earn no commission.

public_facts.title: Affiliate subscription recurring rules, holds, and payout basics
public_facts.summary: Recurring commissions apply only to governed qualifying subscription payment sequences (payments 1-3 at 30%, payments 4+ at 5%). Subscription cancellation produces no new commission. Commissions are subject to holding and maturity periods for returns, refunds, chargebacks, tax verification, and compliance review. Payouts require payable commissions, meeting the minimum payout threshold ($50.00), verified tax and payout profiles, and human owner authorization. No bonuses exist unless explicitly governed. Budly cannot process payments or authorize payouts.

public_facts.title: Budly Affiliate capabilities and strict boundaries
public_facts.summary: Budly can help Affiliates with compliant campaign ideas, educational product explanations, FTC disclosure phrasing, referral link guidance, and QR code references. Budly cannot approve or suspend an Affiliate, modify commission rates, invent bonuses, alter attribution, erase financial history, authorize payouts, or reveal private information about other Affiliates or customers.
